missing_evidence: Postgres server-side metrics: active/waiting connections, max_connections, and pool wait time on order service
candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show pool idle=0 but no direct Postgres saturation metrics; upstream inventory/payment calls succeed, so failure is localized to save_order.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s trace to order service: postgres.save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable at pool size 5/idle 0, order returns 503, gateway sees ReadTimeout on /v1/orders and returns 502. Inventory and payment calls succeed, isolating the fault to the order-to-postgres path consistent with pool exhaustion.
